name: Marcus
label: man · 30s · deep, dramatic thriller
description: A man in his thirties with a deep, resonant, slightly husky voice. Dramatic thriller narrator with tension and gravitas, controlled and intense, never shouting.
ref_text: The old house at the end of the lane had stood empty for many years. Each autumn, the leaves gathered on its steps, and the village children wondered who had lived there, and why they had never come back.
